result:
I added the three new search fields to the Desligamentos screen, but I haven't confirmed they work. The only specs that exercise this screen (`spec/features/dismissals_spec.rb`) need a Selenium browser driver, which isn't available here, so they errored out before running. I also didn't write new tests for the filters.

What changed:
- **Ano:** a text field. It matches the year of the dismissal date by comparing against 1 January to 31 December of that year, so it doesn't depend on the database's date functions. A value that isn't exactly four digits returns no results instead of an error message. That is weaker than the "clear validation message" in the spec.
- **Motivo do Desligamento:** a select that filters on the dismissal reason. I added this because the repo has a `dismissal_reason` association for it. I read "tipo de desligamento" as that. If you meant something else, that is the part to change.
- **Nível da Matrícula:** a select, listing the `Level` records. It filters on the level of the enrollment, not on any level at the time of dismissal.

The existing Matrícula filter is unchanged. Empty fields don't restrict the results.

The edits are in `app/controllers/dismissals_controller.rb`, `app/helpers/dismissals_helper.rb` (the level select) and `config/locales/dismissal.pt-BR.yml` (labels "Ano" and "Nível da Matrícula"). `ruby -c` passes on the controller and the helper. I haven't tried the screen in a running app.
